evidence.reason: In `main()`, `--report` is written after `build()` without comparing it to `--output` or the derived provenance and `.sha256` paths. `build()` never receives `args.report`, so it cannot perform that check. A `--report` equal to the archive path overwrites the just-built archive with report JSON and the command still exits 0; the same collision can overwrite the provenance or sidecar file. This is an ordinary correctness defect in existing behavior, not a new requirement.
